Time passes при a tremendous pace within the Sisyphe System, unhindered на material resistance. Yet through their respective viewpoints, the Giants can synchronize themselves with the System's internal flow of time и communicate with its customers.

Among them, the Giant who represents the Hammers holds authority over the System's internal memories и time, with the power to сбрасывает portions of its inventory при his own discretion.

Revulsion. Nausea before the world. The world simply exists. Nothing in it bears any inherent meaning; everything before our eyes is merely the product of chance.

Everything is a contingency. Everything.
